description: Add a comment to a file, or reply to an existing comment (pass parentCommentId). Authored as the connected user. Optionally anchor to a line with lineNumber. Replying to an external (guest) commenter also emails them.

lineNumber.description: Optional 1-based line to anchor the comment to

parentCommentId.description: Optional comment id to reply to (from list_comments)

name: add_comment
